item.title: Sure, let’s smoosh SpaceX and Tesla together, who cares
item.description: Mars not depicted. | Image: Cath Virginia / The Verge, Getty Images Oh sure, SpaceX's credit risk is pretty high because it's about to borrow another $40 billion to spend on Nvidia chips , but who cares about that? SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss a merger! The degree to which you find this merger compelling likely has to do with the degree to which you believe Elon Musk about wanting to go to Mars, or "spread the light of consciousness," as he put it in this week's SpaceX earnings call (and earlier S-1). Now, a reasonably informed person knows that we don't have the technology - or, frankly, even the raw information to build the technology - in order to support human life in space. … Read the full story at The Verge.

item.title: APC using statistics to tell lies, fighting on all fronts — Dele Momodu
item.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye The Deputy Director-General, Media and Communications of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential campaign, Dele Momodu, has accused the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) of using economic statistics to mislead Nigerians, alleging that President Bola Tinubu’s administration is fighting criticism from international institutions while struggling to win public confidence ahead of the 2027 presidential election. Momodu, who is backing ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar, made the remarks on Channels Television’s Politics Today on Thursday, while questioning the government’s presentation of economic figures and the credibility of the electoral process. “I saw the speech of an Emir in the North, I wish we had a lot of time, I would have read it to you. They were told the brutal truth that you should never lie to the people. What the APC is doing today is to use those statistics to tell lies and to say The World Bank are for us, The IMF are for us,” he said. He accused the government of attacking international institutions when their assessments raise concerns about Nigeria’s economic direction and borrowing. “Whenever the World Bank says, oh, we are worried about the direction you are going, the loans you’re taking is becoming horrendous, then they fight the World Bank. “If the Economist comes and writes and says, oh, the direction Nigeria is going, we know you are likely to force your way in to win the election, they will fight The Economist. So they are fighting on all fronts,” Momodu said. Momodu questions INEC over voter register The ADC chieftain also questioned the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), arguing that the commission should publish the voters’ register to enable Nigerians to scrutinise the electoral process. He said the figures being cited for registered voters and party membership raised questions about the relationship between party strength and the wider electorate. “For INEC just to do a simple job is obligatory. Publish the voters’ register. Now they say we have 103 million registered voters. Fantastic. Yesterday, I saw your guest, a senator of APC, boasting, we have 12 million registered members of our party. And the next party has maybe about 4 million registered voters. “But INEC is telling us we have 103 million registered voters. So they are fighting on all fronts,” Momodu said. Momodu questions INEC over voter register The ADC chieftain also questioned the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), arguing that the commission should publish the voters’ register to enable Nigerians to scrutinise the electoral process. He said the figures being cited for registered voters and party membership raised questions about the relationship between party strength and the wider electorate. “For INEC just to do a simple job is obligatory. Publish the voters’ register. Now they say we have 103 million registered voters. Fantastic. Yesterday, I saw your guest, a senator of APC, boasting, we have 12 million registered members of our party. And the next party has maybe about 4 million registered voters. “But INEC is telling us we have 103 million registered voters. So tell me, will 12 million people override the will and wishes of 103 million people?” he asked. Momodu argued that Nigerians who were not firmly aligned with any political party could play a decisive role in the election, describing them as the “floaters party”. “What that tells you immediately is that the largest political party in Nigeria, it’s not APC, it’s not ADC, it is the floaters party and the floaters are the ones crying today that their lives are in a big mess,” he said. ‘Hunger’ can defeat Tinubu Momodu also blamed a lack of sincerity within the government for what he described as shortcomings in economic management, arguing that officials were not giving the president the full picture. “What is lacking in this government is that sincerity. Everything is about one man. The people who are running our economy today have to tell Nigerians only what they think the president wants to hear. They are not telling him the truth, and when tomorrow comes, he will realise it, it’s just that it may be too late,” he said. Asked how the opposition could defeat Tinubu in 2027, Momodu argued that economic hardship could prove decisive regardless of the ruling party’s political support. “There is no permutation that will beat hunger. That is the truth. Bola Tinubu can bring all the governors in the world, and I just told you we saw it in Osun…” he said. item.title: Teenage Engineering launched an instrument amp with a ton of built-in effects
item.description: It looks exactly like what you’d expect a Teenage Engineering guitar amp to look like. | Image: Teenage Engineering Teenage Engineering is branching out into instrument amps with the previously leaked EP-35 , a multi-input, multi-instrument, battery-powered amp with built-in effects. The back of the unit has a line-in port, as well as a 1/4-inch guitar input and an XLR input for mics, including mics that require phantom power. You can also stream audio to it via Bluetooth and connect multiple EP-35s together over Bluetooth using Auracast . If you have them paired in stereo, tilting a unit to the left or right sets it to the appropriate stereo channel, which is pretty neat. item.title: Baker Mayfield is confident his thumb is strong enough to play
item.description: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield hasn’t played since Week 3 due to a thumb injury. He dislocated his right thumb in the Bucs’ 23-16 loss to the Minnesota Vikings . The Bucs are 1-2 since Mayfield went down, with Jalon Daniels starting in place of the former Sooner . Daniels has been decent for Tampa Bay, but turnovers have plagued him in their two losses. He threw four interceptions in those two losses and was sacked eight times. Tampa Bay will have to do a better job protecting their QB, no matter who’s starting. Everyone is asking the million-dollar question. Will Mayfield play against the Carolina Panthers in Week 7? MORE: Justin Jefferson, Brock Bowers & more fantasy football injury updates for Week 7 Will Baker Mayfield play against the Panthers in Week 7? Jan 3, 2026; Tampa, Florida, USA; Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (6) throws a pass against the Carolina Panthers in the first half at Raymond James Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Nathan Ray Seebeck-Imagn Images Baker Mayfield said he thinks that his thumb is strong enough to play in an NFL game. He was meeting with reporters and said ,” We’ve gotten it to a place where it’s strong enough to be able to play” He also added that: “You always want to be out there with your guys. But just doing the rehab process as much as possible each and every day and trying to recover as quickly as possible. And take it one day at a time. So, it’s been feeling better and better. But that’s the frustrating part. It just takes time with an injury like that.” Buccaneers listed QB Baker Mayfield as a full participant in today’s practice. — Adam Schefter (@AdamSchefter) October 21, 2026 Mayfield was listed as a full participant in Wednesday’s practice, so he’s on track to play against their NFC South Division rival. You know the Heisman Trophy winner will want to light up the team that gave up on him. The first TD of the game belongs to Emeka Egbuka and the @Buccaneers ! CLEvsTB on CBS/Paramount+ Stream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/zySD83pgjr — NFL (@NFL) September 20, 2026 Mayfield was 0-3 before he missed time, but he threw three touchdowns in those games. He was constantly under pressure and was sacked 13 times in those first three contests of the year. Mayfield is 6-1 against the Panthers in his career with 10 passing touchdowns. — Enjoy free coverage of the top news & trending stories with The Big Lead Newsletter —

item.title: Stop announcing how much your movie made at the cinema — Filmmaker Biodun Stephen tells colleagues
item.description: Nollywood filmmaker Biodun Stephen has urged colleagues to stop announcing cinema earnings, warning that the practice puts unnecessary pressure on other filmmakers and creates a narrow definition of success in the industry. Stephen made the remarks during Paul & Baaj: In Character podcast, where she argued that publicising box office figures could distract filmmakers from focusing on the quality and impact of their work. “I think that we really should do away with the announcements,” she said. “I feel like this is a distractions and it puts pressure on those other people who… feel as if that is the determine and that’s how you determine my success,” she added. The filmmaker explained that frequent announcements of cinema earnings could make others feel unsuccessful if their projects failed to achieve similar figures. Using a slippers business as an example, Stephen said people often rush to replicate successful ventures without understanding the effort and strategy behind them. “Somebody starts selling slippers and people are rushing to buy slippers, the next one… is going to sell slippers… because they think that slippers sells, meanwhile they don’t understand what you have put in to ensure the slipper sells.” Biodun Stephen also questioned the tendency among some filmmakers and actors to pursue international recognition before establishing a strong presence in Nigeria. “It’s great to hunger for more, but I always say, have you even conquered Nigeria that can you stand and say that if I go to Kano they know me as an actor?” She further argued that box office earnings alone were insufficient to determine a film’s quality, longevity or potential to reach international audiences. According to her, a film could generate substantial cinema revenue without necessarily being outstanding, while a well-made production with export potential might earn less and receive little recognition. “The film go tough but it can be a lot of crap and then the film that is really good that can travel, that has export value can do 40 million… the only yard stick for measuring success is this very shallow number.” Explaining her approach to filmmaking, Stephen said her motivation was rooted in purpose rather than the pursuit of box office records or audience numbers. “I’m doing it because I am living a life of purpose, I’m not chasing the numbers, I’m not chasing the audience.” She added that the emotional impact of her stories and the difference they made in people’s lives were more meaningful to her than industry awards. “When people call me to pray… and cry and say thank you so much, Jesus, my work is done, no award.” Vanguard News The post Stop announcing how much your movie made at the cinema — Filmmaker Biodun Stephen tells colleagues appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Hamburg injuries clear as Merlin Polzin targets fourth consecutive Bundesliga victory
item.description: Hamburg injuries clear as Merlin Polzin targets fourth consecutive Bundesliga victory Hamburg head coach Merlin Polzin has received a welcome personnel boost ahead of Saturday’s Bundesliga trip to SC Paderborn. Patson Daka, Albert Sambi Lokonga, and Bakery Jatta are all available again after recovering from their respective injury problems. The returning trio provide the 35-year-old with additional options as Hamburger SV attempt to secure a fourth consecutive Bundesliga victory. Speaking at Thursday’s pre-match press conference, Polzin confirmed that the three players had participated extensively in training during the week, with some completing full sessions. Captain Nicolai Remberg and the suspended Mario Vuskovic remain unavailable, but the coach was otherwise pleased with his squad’s improving fitness situation. The welcome developments nevertheless present Polzin with something of a selection dilemma. Following HSV’s dramatic 1-0 victory over VfB Stuttgart last weekend , the Hanseaten have now won three consecutive Bundesliga matches for the first time in 16 years. “For us, this is an outstanding situation to be in,” Polzin said on Thursday. “We have players who are performing, delivering results, and helping the team succeed. Competition for places does something to a team.” The coach emphasized that his returning players must earn their opportunities through their performances in training. He also praised the contributions of his substitutes, who have repeatedly influenced matches during HSV’s recent winning streak. “Everyone is eager and making it very difficult for me to decide who will start,” Polzin said. Hamburg’s remarkable resurgence follows disastrous Bundesliga start HSV’s improving fortunes represent a remarkable reversal from the opening weeks of the campaign. Polzin’s team lost their first three Bundesliga fixtures without scoring a goal, conceding 12 times in defeats against Borussia Dortmund, Mainz 05, and RB Leipzig. Despite the disastrous start, Hamburg’s leadership reaffirmed its faith in Polzin by extending the contracts of the entire coaching staff . The decision came immediately before the fourth matchday, when HSV finally secured their first victory of the season against 1. FC Köln . A dramatic 3-2 comeback victory away at Hoffenheim followed, before Swiss international Miro Muheim struck another spectacular late winner against Stuttgart. The improvement has nevertheless come at a significant personnel cost. Remberg sustained a serious knee injury during the Hoffenheim encounter , subsequently underwent surgery for a torn ACL, and faces a lengthy spell on the sidelines. His absence, combined with Sambi Lokonga’s muscular problems, forced Polzin to reconsider his midfield arrangements. item.content:encoded: Hamburg injuries clear as Merlin Polzin targets fourth consecutive Bundesliga victory Hamburg head coach Merlin Polzin has received a welcome personnel boost ahead of Saturday’s Bundesliga trip to SC Paderborn. Patson Daka, Albert Sambi Lokonga, and Bakery Jatta are all available again after recovering from their respective injury problems. The returning trio provide the 35-year-old with additional options as Hamburger SV attempt to secure a fourth consecutive Bundesliga victory. Speaking at Thursday’s pre-match press conference, Polzin confirmed that the three players had participated extensively in training during the week, with some completing full sessions. Captain Nicolai Remberg and the suspended Mario Vuskovic remain unavailable, but the coach was otherwise pleased with his squad’s improving fitness situation. The welcome developments nevertheless present Polzin with something of a selection dilemma. Following HSV’s dramatic 1-0 victory over VfB Stuttgart last weekend , the Hanseaten have now won three consecutive Bundesliga matches for the first time in 16 years. “For us, this is an outstanding situation to be in,” Polzin said on Thursday. “We have players who are performing, delivering results, and helping the team succeed. Competition for places does something to a team.” The coach emphasized that his returning players must earn their opportunities through their performances in training. He also praised the contributions of his substitutes, who have repeatedly influenced matches during HSV’s recent winning streak. “Everyone is eager and making it very difficult for me to decide who will start,” Polzin said. Hamburg’s remarkable resurgence follows disastrous Bundesliga start HSV’s improving fortunes represent a remarkable reversal from the opening weeks of the campaign. Polzin’s team lost their first three Bundesliga fixtures without scoring a goal, conceding 12 times in defeats against Borussia Dortmund, Mainz 05, and RB Leipzig. Despite the disastrous start, Hamburg’s leadership reaffirmed its faith in Polzin by extending the contracts of the entire coaching staff . The decision came immediately before the fourth matchday, when HSV finally secured their first victory of the season against 1. FC Köln . A dramatic 3-2 comeback victory away at Hoffenheim followed, before Swiss international Miro Muheim struck another spectacular late winner against Stuttgart. The improvement has nevertheless come at a significant personnel cost. Remberg sustained a serious knee injury during the Hoffenheim encounter , subsequently underwent surgery for a torn ACL, and faces a lengthy spell on the sidelines. His absence, combined with Sambi Lokonga’s muscular problems, forced Polzin to reconsider his midfield arrangements. Polzin’s tactical adjustments and Muheim’s resurgence The HSV coach has repeatedly emphasized the importance of tactical flexibility, having already altered his team’s approach several times since assuming responsibility in November 2024. Polzin initially sought to introduce a more progressive possession-based game during the summer, but HSV’s dreadful start prompted a renewed emphasis on defensive stability and compactness. The effects have been striking. Hamburg averaged only slightly more than 37 percent possession across their recent three-match winning streak, including just 34 percent against Stuttgart. The personnel adjustments have been equally important. With Remberg and Sambi Lokonga unavailable, Polzin deployed Martin Adeline, Bilal Nadir, and Muheim in an unfamiliar central midfield configuration against Stuttgart. Muheim’s emergence has been particularly significant. The 28-year-old began the campaign struggling to reclaim his customary position on the left flank following injury problems and increased competition from David Møller Wolfe and Louis Lemke. The Swiss international nevertheless embraced his new central role and has now scored decisive goals in consecutive Bundesliga victories. His remarkable turnaround has become emblematic of HSV’s collective recovery . Polzin has also been particularly encouraged by the impact of his substitutes. Against Stuttgart, Albert Grønbæk and Zakaria El Ouahdi entered the match in the 78th minute and combined to create Muheim’s late winner. The coach believes opponents are beginning to recognize the threat HSV pose during the closing stages of matches. “When the opposing team knows that HSV steps things up towards the end of a match, that’s of incredible value,” Polzin explained. More options available ahead of Paderborn trip The returns of Daka, Sambi Lokonga, and Jatta could provide another boost, although Polzin has given no indication that all three will immediately return to the starting XI. Sambi Lokonga offers a potential solution to HSV’s midfield absences, while Daka and Jatta increase the coach’s attacking options. Saturday’s opponents Paderborn have collected just five points from their opening six Bundesliga fixtures. GGFN | Peter Weis

item.title: Ranking the best teammate duos in the NBA for the 2026-27 season
item.description: It's no easy assignment to rank anything about the NBA this early in the season. But there are some one-two punches that project to look outstanding. Talent always rises to the top, which is why we used USA TODAY's top 100 player rankings to anchor our decisions. But how players elevate each other is equally, if not more, important. Whether it's on the offensive or the defensive end of the floor, it leads to winning basketball. It matters to not just look at counting stats but dive a little deeper for these evaluations. The good news is that there are plenty of resources available to us on NBA.com and PBPStats that help contextualize how well a duo has played together. These metrics tell us how a team performed when both players shared the court. Offensive rating measures how many points a team scored per 100 possessions with a given duo on the floor while defensive rating measures how many points a team allowed per 100 possessions with that duo on the floor. Net rating is the difference between those two numbers. For example, a +10 net rating means that a team outscored opponents by 10 points per 100 possessions when the duo shared the court, while a -10 net rating means the team was outscored by 10 points per 100 possessions. To reduce the impact of small-sample noise, we adjusted ratings toward the league average. Lineups that played more minutes retained more of their actual performance, while lineups with fewer minutes were pulled closer to average. You can check out our individual rankings here . But below are the best duos in the NBA entering the 2026-27 season. 1. NEW YORK KNICKS: Jalen Brunson (6), Karl-Anthony Towns (16) Net Rating = 5.2 As the centerpiece of the reigning NBA champions, Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns claim the top spot on this list. The Knicks outscored opponents by 192 total points when Brunson and Towns shared the court during the 2026 playoffs, per NBA.com . That ranked second-best (behind just Brunson and OG Anunoby, which would have also earned its own spot in the ten best duos if we included multiple pairings from the same team) among all two-man lineups in the playoffs. They have found ways to make the game easier for each other. Towns shot 40.2 percent on 3-pointers when sharing the court with Brunson but 35.4 percent when he did not. Brunson, meanwhile, shot 65.7 percent at the rim with Towns on the court and 59.6 percent without him. While they still need to figure out a long-term contract extension for Towns, his pairing with Brunson is one that clearly worked down the stretch and warrants the top spot on this list. 2. DENVER NUGGETS: Nikola Jokić (2), Jamal Murray (21) Net Rating = 10.8 The 2023 NBA champions have the most long-standing chemistry of any duo on this list, and it’s not fading: Jamal Murray finally made his first NBA All-Star appearance last season. When including the playoffs, via PBPStats , Nikola Jokić and Murray combined to assist each other 344 times last season. That was 100 more as
item.content:encoded: It's no easy assignment to rank anything about the NBA this early in the season. But there are some one-two punches that project to look outstanding. Talent always rises to the top, which is why we used USA TODAY's top 100 player rankings to anchor our decisions. But how players elevate each other is equally, if not more, important. Whether it's on the offensive or the defensive end of the floor, it leads to winning basketball. It matters to not just look at counting stats but dive a little deeper for these evaluations. The good news is that there are plenty of resources available to us on NBA.com and PBPStats that help contextualize how well a duo has played together. These metrics tell us how a team performed when both players shared the court. Offensive rating measures how many points a team scored per 100 possessions with a given duo on the floor while defensive rating measures how many points a team allowed per 100 possessions with that duo on the floor. Net rating is the difference between those two numbers. For example, a +10 net rating means that a team outscored opponents by 10 points per 100 possessions when the duo shared the court, while a -10 net rating means the team was outscored by 10 points per 100 possessions. To reduce the impact of small-sample noise, we adjusted ratings toward the league average. Lineups that played more minutes retained more of their actual performance, while lineups with fewer minutes were pulled closer to average. You can check out our individual rankings here . But below are the best duos in the NBA entering the 2026-27 season. 1. NEW YORK KNICKS: Jalen Brunson (6), Karl-Anthony Towns (16) Net Rating = 5.2 As the centerpiece of the reigning NBA champions, Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns claim the top spot on this list. The Knicks outscored opponents by 192 total points when Brunson and Towns shared the court during the 2026 playoffs, per NBA.com . That ranked second-best (behind just Brunson and OG Anunoby, which would have also earned its own spot in the ten best duos if we included multiple pairings from the same team) among all two-man lineups in the playoffs. They have found ways to make the game easier for each other. Towns shot 40.2 percent on 3-pointers when sharing the court with Brunson but 35.4 percent when he did not. Brunson, meanwhile, shot 65.7 percent at the rim with Towns on the court and 59.6 percent without him. While they still need to figure out a long-term contract extension for Towns, his pairing with Brunson is one that clearly worked down the stretch and warrants the top spot on this list. 2. DENVER NUGGETS: Nikola Jokić (2), Jamal Murray (21) Net Rating = 10.8 The 2023 NBA champions have the most long-standing chemistry of any duo on this list, and it’s not fading: Jamal Murray finally made his first NBA All-Star appearance last season. When including the playoffs, via PBPStats , Nikola Jokić and Murray combined to assist each other 344 times last season. That was 100 more assists than any other duo in the league and marked the fourth consecutive season that Jokić and Murray led the NBA in that category. Using our minutes-weighted stabilization method, the Jokić-Murray duo produced the second-best adjusted offense in the NBA among more than 2,000 two-man combinations last season. It ranked as the best overall in 2024-25. Even though Murray missed the 2021-22 season, they have now finished among the top ten in this category in five of the last six seasons they played together. 3. OKLAHOMA CITY THUNDER: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (1), Jalen Williams (22) Net Rating = 13.3 Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is the back-to-back NBA MVP winner but he has an impressive running mate, too. Jalen Williams was very limited by injury last season, but during his last fully healthy season, this duo won an NBA Finals together. Under our minutes-weighted stabilization method, the time that Gilgeous-Alexander shared the court with Williams last year led to one of the five best adjusted two-man net ratings (17.0) in the NBA. This was the second year in a row they finished top ten in this category. Oklahoma City is going to contend for a long time, especially so long as Gilgeous-Alexander and Williams are both playing even close to the caliber of basketball we have seen from them. 4. PHILADELPHIA 76ERS: Tyrese Maxey (14), Jaylen Brown (15) Net Rating = N/A The fun thing about this duo is we won’t actually know which players on the 76ers will emerge as the most important on the team until later in the season when we’ve seen how they all blend together. But based on health and age indicators, we can assume that Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown will probably play the biggest roles for Philadelphia. During their Opening Night victory over the Knicks, the 76ers outscored the defending champions by 17 points when these two players shared the floor. Maxey and Brown will have their play elevated by playing alongside LeBron James and Joel Embiid. However, as the likely stars of the show, this team will go as far as they can take them. 5. SAN ANTONIO SPURS: Victor Wembanyama (3), Stephon Castle (28) Net Rating = 11.2 The future is obviously bright for the Spurs, led by back-to-back NBA Rookie of the Year winners Victor Wembanyama and Stephon Castle. Their adjusted net rating during the regular season (14.7) ranked in the top 20 among the 2,000+ two-man lineup combinations. During the Spurs' run to the Western Conference title, Wembanyama and Castle combined to assist each other 62 times. No other duo combined to assist each other more than 45 times in the postseason, per PBPStats . Castle is able to take shots at the rim more frequently ( 41.6 percent vs. 29.5 percent ) with a much higher overall shooting efficiency (55.6 eFG% vs. 47.5 eFG%) when Wembanyama is on the court compared to when he is not. Wembanyama has gotten attempts at the rim more frequently alongside Castle ( 38.8 percent ) compared to without him (32.1 percent) as well. 6. LOS ANGELES LAKERS: Luka Dončić (4), Austin Reaves (32) Net Rating (5-year max.): 7.2 If you were to imagine a perfect teammate for Luka Dončić in theory, it’s probably not Austin Reaves. Their skill sets aren’t as theoretically complementary as they have been in practice. The Lakers were outscored when Dončić played without Reaves (-0.7 net rating) and when Reaves played without Dončić (-4.8). Yet when they shared the floor, the Lakers outscored opponents by 9.2 points per 100 possessions . The numbers suggest that when they share the floor, something just clicks. The two players are able to get the most out of each other, and with LeBron James no longer in the picture and Walker Kessler as an ideal post player added to their starting lineup, both could elevate even more in 2026-27. HONORABLE MENTIONS Early returns look fantastic for Edwards and Ball for the Timberwolves, though injuries for Haliburton and Irving have made the Pacers and Mavericks more difficult to predict. We will still need to see more from the Giannis-Bam pairing and the Kawhi-Barnes duo before making a full assessment, too. MIAMI HEAT: Giannis Antetokounmpo (5) and Bam Adebayo (20) MINNESOTA TIMBERWOLVES: Anthony Edwards (7) and LaMelo Ball (33) TORONTO RAPTORS: Kawhi Leonard (10) and Scottie Barnes (24) CLEVELAND CAVALIERS: Donovan Mitchell (13), Evan Mobley (36) INDIANA PACERS: Tyrese Haliburton (17) and Pascal Siakam (30) DETROIT PISTONS: Cade Cunningham (8) and Jalen Duren (39) HOUSTON ROCKETS: Kevin Durant (12) and Amen Thompson (29) BOSTON CELTICS: Jayson Tatum (8) and Derrick White (46) DALLAS MAVERICKS: Cooper Flagg (31) and Kyrie Irving (35) ORLANDO MAGIC: Paolo Banchero (34) and Franz Wagner (42) This article originally appeared on For The Win: Ranking the best teammate duos in the NBA for the 2026-27 season

item.title: Detroit Red Wings Announce 3 Roster Moves, Including Emergency Goalie Recall
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings announced three roster moves Thursday afternoon as they continue their four-game road trip, including the emergency recall of a goaltender who has been outstanding in the American Hockey League. Detroit officially activated forward J.T. Compher from injured reserve, recalled goaltender Michal Postava from the Grand Rapids Griffins under emergency conditions, and assigned forward Sheldon Dries to Grand Rapids. The moves come ahead of Thursday night’s matchup against the Vancouver Canucks and provide some welcome injury-related news, along with an intriguing development in Detroit’s goaltending situation. Apr 15, 2026; Sunrise, Florida, USA; Detroit Red Wings left wing J.T. Compher (37) moves the puck against the Florida Panthers during the first period at Amerant Bank Arena. Mandatory Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Detroit Red Wings Announce 3 Roster Moves According to the team’s official announcement Thursday, the Red Wings made the following transactions: J.T. Compher (F): Activated from injured reserve. Michal Postava (G): Recalled from Grand Rapids under emergency conditions. Sheldon Dries (F): Assigned to Grand Rapids. Compher’s activation is particularly encouraging after the veteran forward missed time with an undisclosed injury. The 31-year-old had been sidelined since early October, leaving head coach Todd McLellan without an experienced option in his forward rotation. As we previously reported when Detroit placed Compher on injured reserve , his absence added to an already difficult injury situation involving Marco Kasper and Mason Appleton. Compher was originally placed on injured reserve retroactive to October 4 , making Thursday’s activation a positive development for Detroit’s forward depth. Michal Postava Receives Emergency Recall After Dominating AHL Perhaps the most intriguing move involves Postava, who has been nearly unbeatable with Grand Rapids this season. The 24-year-old Czech goaltender has started the 2026-27 campaign with a perfect 4-0-0 record, a 1.25 goals-against average, and a .954 save percentage . His impressive play recently earned him AHL Player of the Week honors after a dominant stretch in which he stopped 58 of 60 shots. The American Hockey League recognized Postava’s performance on October 12. However, the emergency designation raises an important question about Detroit’s current goaltending situation. The Red Wings have not explained in their roster announcement why the emergency recall was necessary or whether John Gibson or Daniil Tarasov is dealing with an injury. For now, Postava provides another available option between the pipes as Detroit continues its road trip. Meanwhile, Dries returns to Grand Rapids after helping fill Detroit’s forward-depth needs earlier this month. item.title: ‘No Longer Just a Sports Story,’ ‘(Roger Goodell) Could Be in Trouble’ — Fans React As Senator Lisa Blunt Rochester Asks NFL for ‘Answers’ About Jalen Hurts
item.description: ‘No Longer Just a Sports Story,’ ‘(Roger Goodell) Could Be in Trouble’ — Fans React As Senator Lisa Blunt Rochester Asks NFL for ‘Answers’ About Jalen Hurts Jalen Hurts’ blood clots have already cost the Philadelphia Eagles their starting quarterback, who is on injured reserve and expected to miss the rest of the season. On Wednesday, the questions about how the team handled his care reached the U.S. Senate, when Sen. Lisa Blunt Rochester, D-Del., sent NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell a letter asking whether the league will review the Eagles’ handling of the situation. A Senator’s Letter Brings Congress Into the Jalen Hurts Questions Blunt Rochester, who sits on the Senate’s Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions (HELP) committee and its Commerce, Science, and Transportation committee, put five questions to Goodell. They ask whether the NFL has a league-wide protocol for detecting, preventing, and treating deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE), what standards govern a player’s clearance when a clot is suspected, what education players, trainers, and coaches receive and what the league does about the risk tied to long flights. The fifth goes straight at the Eagles: “Will the League conduct a thorough review of the Eagles’ handling of this specific situation, including who cleared Mr. Hurts to play after staying awake overnight, and cleared subsequent air travel on a transatlantic flight back to the U.S. from London?” League executive vice president Jeff Miller disputed a report that Hurts was awake for more than 30 hours before he played the Jacksonville Jaguars, according to The Associated Press. SEE THIS WEEK’S INJURIES: PFN’s NFL Injury Report Fans replying to a post from podcaster Tony Farmer turned on Goodell and the handling of Hurts’ care. Farmer, posting the next morning, didn’t hold back about where the saga now stands: “This story has gone nuclear. No longer just a sports story and for good reason.” The London trip the senator asked about was the Eagles’ Oct. 11 game against the Jaguars at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. According to ABC News, Hurts played that game after specialists in London first diagnosed a superficial vein thrombosis in his left calf. The clot later traveled to his lungs, and on Monday, the Eagles and his agent, Nicole Lynn, said he has DVT and bilateral pulmonary emboli. Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni defended the team’s handling of his condition at a news conference that same day. item.content:encoded: ‘No Longer Just a Sports Story,’ ‘(Roger Goodell) Could Be in Trouble’ — Fans React As Senator Lisa Blunt Rochester Asks NFL for ‘Answers’ About Jalen Hurts Jalen Hurts’ blood clots have already cost the Philadelphia Eagles their starting quarterback, who is on injured reserve and expected to miss the rest of the season. On Wednesday, the questions about how the team handled his care reached the U.S. Senate, when Sen. Lisa Blunt Rochester, D-Del., sent NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell a letter asking whether the league will review the Eagles’ handling of the situation. A Senator’s Letter Brings Congress Into the Jalen Hurts Questions Blunt Rochester, who sits on the Senate’s Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions (HELP) committee and its Commerce, Science, and Transportation committee, put five questions to Goodell. They ask whether the NFL has a league-wide protocol for detecting, preventing, and treating deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE), what standards govern a player’s clearance when a clot is suspected, what education players, trainers, and coaches receive and what the league does about the risk tied to long flights. The fifth goes straight at the Eagles: “Will the League conduct a thorough review of the Eagles’ handling of this specific situation, including who cleared Mr. Hurts to play after staying awake overnight, and cleared subsequent air travel on a transatlantic flight back to the U.S. from London?” League executive vice president Jeff Miller disputed a report that Hurts was awake for more than 30 hours before he played the Jacksonville Jaguars, according to The Associated Press. SEE THIS WEEK’S INJURIES: PFN’s NFL Injury Report Fans replying to a post from podcaster Tony Farmer turned on Goodell and the handling of Hurts’ care. Farmer, posting the next morning, didn’t hold back about where the saga now stands: “This story has gone nuclear. No longer just a sports story and for good reason.” The London trip the senator asked about was the Eagles’ Oct. 11 game against the Jaguars at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. According to ABC News, Hurts played that game after specialists in London first diagnosed a superficial vein thrombosis in his left calf. The clot later traveled to his lungs, and on Monday, the Eagles and his agent, Nicole Lynn, said he has DVT and bilateral pulmonary emboli. Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni defended the team’s handling of his condition at a news conference that same day. BE THE GM OF YOUR FAVORITE TEAM: PFN’s Free NFL Mock Draft Simulator Blunt Rochester has worked on blood clot legislation throughout her time in Congress, including the Charles Rochester Blood Clot Prevention and Treatment Act, which is named for her late husband. Her letter explains why the issue is personal: “My late husband and the love of my life, Charles Rochester, tore his Achilles tendon playing a game of pickup basketball before a business meeting. Blood clots traveled to his heart and lungs and, at the age of 52, he died.” Fans Press Roger Goodell as the League Stands by Its Protocols One fan went after the commissioner himself: “Goodell is arrogant and does not like to be questioned. Now things are changing and he could be in trouble.” Another fan wrote: “Goodell is legit insane.” Goodell did take questions Wednesday at the news conference that closed the league’s fall meeting in New York. Responding to the NFL Players Association’s call for a full investigation into the Eagles’ handling of Hurts’ blood clots, he said: “We welcome that. That’s part of our processes. That’s fine.” PREDICT THE NFL SEASON: PFN’s Free NFL Playoff Predictor Another fan went after the medical decisions themselves: “Malpractice of the highest order and there needs to be a reckoning.” The league has stood by the care Hurts received. Dr. Allen Sills, the NFL’s chief medical officer, defended the Eagles’ medical staff at a news conference Tuesday, and a day later, Goodell pointed to Sills’ review: “Obviously, there was a medical evaluation, and I think our protocols were incredibly good there. The protocols were followed. Our process is to make sure that’s the case, and our chief medical officer has gone through that, so we’re comfortable that what we’ve seen in the protocols have happened.” Another fan simply welcomed the scrutiny: “Good, it’s about time!” One user on X added, “This is the type of [expletive] politicians should be involved with when it comes to sports.” Blunt Rochester’s letter also asks the league for a timeline if it conducts a review, and she requests a briefing for her office and members of the HELP committee. Hurts, meanwhile, is being treated with blood thinners and won’t be allowed to take part in any football activities until he is off them. The Eagles, 2-4 and second in the NFC East, host the Dallas Cowboys on Monday night. This article originally appeared on Pro Football Network .

item.title: Penders To Start | 3-4-3 Chelsea Predicted Lineup Vs Tottenham Hotspur
item.description: Penders To Start | 3-4-3 Chelsea Predicted Lineup Vs Tottenham Hotspur Chelsea will welcome Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge this Saturday as they hope to earn a win at home in the London derby. The Blues managed to secure a solid 2-0 victory away at Everton recently, which should give them some confidence going into this game. Xabi Alonso will opt for the 3-4-3 formation and is expected to make one tweak to his starting XI for this contest. Mike Penders could get a chance to impress from the start of this game. 3-4-3 Chelsea Predicted Lineup To Face Tottenham Hotspur Defence Mike Penders will operate in between the sticks for Chelsea in the injury absence of Emiliano Martinez. Alonso could name a back three of Levi Colwill, Maxence Lacroix and Josh Acheampong for this game. Their main job would be to keep the opposition attackers frustrated throughout the game. Wesley Fofana will offer cover for the defensive positions on the bench. LIVERPOOL, ENGLAND – OCTOBER 17: Referee Paul Tierney speaks with Cole Palmer, Jordan Henderson, Moises Caicedo and Pedro Neto of Chelsea after awarding a corner during the Premier League 2026/27 match between Everton and Chelsea FC at Hill Dickinson Stadium on October 17, 2026 in Liverpool, England. (Photo by Molly Darlington/Getty Images) Midfield Moises Caicedo and Jordan Henderson will play as the holding midfielders for the Blues as they look to dictate the tempo of the game from midfield. Pedro Neto will be a nailed-on starter as the right-sided wide player, while Jorrel Hato hopes to give a good account of himself on the left flank. Both of them will need to make some overlapping runs out in the wide areas. Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer will operate as Alonso’s attacking midfielders as they try to carry most of the creative burden for Chelsea in the final third. Geovany Quenda and Valentin Barco will be named on the bench as they await their chance to influence the game in the second half if required. However, Reece James remains sidelined for Chelsea due to a knee injury. Attack Joao Pedro will lead the charge for the home team up top. He has to figure out a way to be a real threat on the offensive end of the pitch. Danny Welbeck will have to be content with a spot on the bench and might come on to make an impact in the latter stages of the contest if the Blues are in need of a goal by then.

item.title: Lamine Yamal views Barcelona summer signing as a ‘mentor’: ‘He has integrated into his inner circle’
item.description: Lamine Yamal views Barcelona summer signing as a ‘mentor’: ‘He has integrated into his inner circle’ Barcelona star Lamine Yamal has placed a member of the summer recruitment drive at the club into a personal ‘mentoring’ role with a view to the remainder of his career. The Blaugrana star in question? Rodri. Midfielder Rodri of course took his talents to Catalunya’s capital back in August, in a high-profile transfer from Premier League giants Manchester City. The 30-year-old has since quickly integrated himself into Hansi Flick’s XI and the Camp Nou dressing room alike, already considered a key figure in Barcelona. And as alluded to above, one individual who appears to be enjoying particularly significant benefits through Rodri’s presence is fellow countryman Lamine Yamal. As per a report from Tot Costa on Catalan outlet Catalunya Radio, amid what has been a spectacular individual opening to the campaign: ‘Rodri is taking on a very special role with Lamine Yamal. The Barça star has a new mentor in the dressing room, a player he listens to carefully and has integrated directly into his inner circle.’ Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: Meet the 2026 winner of Nikon's Small World photomicrography contest
item.description: A 25-year-old German experimental photographer has won the 2026 Nikon Small World photomicrography competition with a striking image of droplets of ink being deposited on paper by an inkjet printer. Ole Bielfeldt beat out 1,802 other entries hailing from 69 different countries. Bielfeldt became interested in photomicrography during the COVID-19 lockdown after discovering an old microscope in his parents' attic. He figured out how to build an adaptor out of a tube and some wood to connect the microscope to his father's camera and taught himself the art through trial and error, building custom tools as needed. He documents how he captures transformative images of everyday objects with behind-the-scenes videos posted to macrofying , his photography and videography brand. It was Bielfeldt's curiosity about the inner workings of inkjet printers that inspired his winning entry, but capturing the action of ink drops being deposited on paper was a challenge, given that the process happens so quickly. The droplets, for instance, moved faster than the camera's shutter speed. Bielfeldt's solution was to deconstruct the printer so that the paper moved under a stationary (rather than moving) printhead, and then take the image in a dark room, using a flash to serve as the shutter, thereby freezing the ink drops mid-air. There was no need for pricey equipment. Bielfeldt does not use AI in his images, preferring to rely on traditional techniques. Read full article Comments

item.title: Isack Hadjar: Max Verstappen would have won Singapore GP by more in a Ferrari
item.description: Motorsport photo Isack Hadjar has argued that Red Bull did not have the fastest car at the Singapore Grand Prix, and believes his team-mate Max Verstappen would have won by a bigger margin had he been driving a Ferrari . Verstappen heads into this weekend's United States Grand Prix on the back of two consecutive wins at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia and the Singapore Grand Prix. The Dutchman dominated the race weekend at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, claiming pole position for both the sprint race and grand prix, and winning both races. But while speaking in the drivers' press conference in Austin, Hadjar played down suggestions the Milton Keynes outfit now has the fastest car on the grid. "No, because I think the car is still very hard to drive. In Malaysia, it was dominant, but I don't think in Singapore it was the fastest car." When pressed on why, given the four-time champion had won by 7.3 seconds over second-placed Charles Leclerc , Hadjar added: "That’s what I believe. I think if you put Max in the Ferrari, he would have won the race with more margin. So that’s my opinion." Hadjar said Verstappen made the most of every advantage he had, rather than relying on the pace of his Red Bull machinery. Laurent Mekies, Red Bull Racing Team Principal, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing Laurent Mekies, Red Bull Racing Team Principal, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing "He qualified on pole by half a tenth. Ferrari didn’t have new tyres in the race, not on the soft, so this has an effect as well," the French-Algerian driver explained. "He put all the chances on his side, he made the difference in Q3 and that was enough." Interestingly, McLaren's Oscar Piastri , who joined Hadjar in the press conference, said that Red Bull's upgrades introduced at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix were "very strong" and that it had become "the most consistently quick car" over the last few races. With six rounds remaining, Red Bull sits fourth in the constructors' championship, seven points behind McLaren in third. Verstappen is also fourth in the drivers' standings with 221 points, closing in on Lewis Hamilton in third on 229 points, and Hadjar is eighth with 97 points. To read more Motorsport.com articles visit our website .

item.title: Lorenzo Pellegrini Could Miss Two Months With New Thigh Injury
item.description: Lorenzo Pellegrini of A.S. Roma is injured and leaves the field during the UEFA Champions League phase day 3 football match between A.S. Roma and S.K. Slovan Bratislava at the Olympic Stadium in Rome, Italy, on October 20, 2026. (Photo by Domenico Cippitelli/NurPhoto via Getty Images) | NurPhoto via Getty Images This year has been a bit of a whirlwind for Lorenzo Pellegrini. After finishing his ninth season with the club on the sidelines thanks to a nagging hamstring injury, which forced Roma’s former captain to miss the final month of the 2025-2026 season, Pellegrini’s summer was anything but relaxing. From dealing with the embarrassment of Italy missing out on its third-straight World Cup to a rather complicated contract negotiation with Roma’s new leadership to rehabbing his ailing hammy, Pellegrini’s cortisol levels were probably through the roof this summer. With his contract situation settled for another year and his hammy on the mend, Pellegrini made his debut in the club’s scoreless draw against Como earlier this month. He may not have set the world on fire against Cesc Fabregas’ side, but it was a solid first step for Pellegrini, who featured in Roma’s next three matches, including a start in the club’s 4-0 win over Slovan Bratislava on Tuesday. Unfortunately, the good news ends there. After leaving the match in the 51st minute with an apparent leg injury, Pellegrini’s immediate future was in doubt. But was this a garden-variety thigh strain that would limit Pellegrini to individual training for a week or so, or something more serious? As the club prepares for Saturday’s Derby del Sole against Napoli, Pellegrini received some bad news today. According to multiple reports in Italy, Pellegrini suffered a tear of the distal semitendinosus musculotendinous junction in his right thigh, aka the back of his thigh, towards the inner side of the leg—an injury that may keep the 30-year-old Roman on the sidelines for up to two months. Midfield isn’t exactly the deepest part of Roma’s roster, so Pellegrini’s absence could throw a significant spanner in the works.

item.title: Trump calls NBA icon LeBron James 'a TOTAL DISGRACE'
item.description: FILE PHOTO: LeBron James in action during the Men's Gold Medal basketball match US v France, which the US won. President Trump criticized the basketball star for not standing at attention during the national anthem at an NBA game. (is associated with: «Trump calls NBA icon LeBron James 'a TOTAL DISGRACE'») Sven Hoppe/dpa US President Donald Trump on Thursday condemned NBA superstar LeBron James for his behaviour during the national anthem, writing on Truth Social that the 41-year-old basketball player was a "TOTAL DISGRACE" because he did not stand at attention for the national anthem. Trump wrote that James had no respect for his country. The criticism was triggered by videos showing James apparently practising golf swings and then making basketball shooting motions during the national anthem before the opening game of the Philadelphia 76ers, where James plays, against the New York Knicks, the current NBA champions. Trump posted the video of the Tuesday game, which James' team won 106 to 100. It showed other players standing more or less in line while the anthem was sung. Trump said the basketball star "should apologize to all of those Great American Warriors and Heroes who died for the American Flag." The president's post was reposted on X and accompanied by mostly unfavourable comments, many of which called the president a draft dodger and others criticizing his current economic and foreign policies. Trump received four educational deferments and one medical one, according to US press reports. Trump has said he was ineligible to serve due to bone spurs, but many critics have questioned the diagnosis. US President Donald Trump speaks to the press at the White House before departing for South Carolina. He called NBA icon LeBron James 'a total disgrace,' saying James did not stand at attention during the national anthem. (is associated with: «Trump calls NBA icon LeBron James 'a TOTAL DISGRACE'») Matt Kaminsky/ZUMA Press Wire/dpa

item.title: 'Like babies:' Rooney tears into Man Utd squad after Como calamity
item.description: FILE PHOTO - Former English footballer Wayne Rooney pictured prior to the start of the UEFA Champions League soccer match between Atlético Madrid and Manchester United at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium. (is associated with: «'Like babies:' Rooney tears into Man Utd squad after Como calamity») Adam Davy/PA Wire/dpa Wayne Rooney has lambasted Manchester United’s squad for acting like “babies” and urged Bruno Fernandes and Lisandro Martinez to look in the mirror. Fernandes followed Martinez in producing an eye-catching post-match interview on the back of Wednesday’s 4-1 defeat at Como in the Champions League. The result increased the scrutiny on Michael Carrick, who then faced criticism from Fernandes for the game plan in Italy but Rooney has accused the current United captain and Martinez – who pointed the finger at Jason Wilcox – of being selfish. During an appearance on The United Stand podcast, Rooney, who also called for the board to provide clarity regarding Carrick’s future, said: “When Martinez came out, I said this is an absolute nightmare because it will rip the dressing room apart. That was the start. “We’ve seen it now with Bruno and you’re going to see it with more players. The reason why is because them players don’t want to take responsibility. “You can say whether Bruno was right or wrong in what he said, but you have to take responsibility on the pitch, you have to take responsibility as a group of players and there were times when me and Sir Alex Ferguson wouldn’t talk, but I’d run through a brick wall for him on the pitch. “These players, they’re selfish. They care about themselves, they don’t care about their team-mates, don’t care about the manager, about the staff or the fans, they care about themselves. “If they’re not getting what’s right for them. They’re like babies and just throw their toys out of the pram and go and deflect the blame on to anyone else but themselves. They have to look at themselves. “Bruno, he’s having probably the worst run of form he’s had since he’s been at the club and again, it’s no coincidence he’s putting pressure on someone else because he doesn’t want to face it. If he looks at himself in the mirror, if Martinez looks at himself in the mirror, all the players… they’ll find what is looking back at them is them and it’s not good enough.”

item.title: Fernandes set to avoid sanctions over post-match Carrick criticism
item.description: FILE PHOTO - Manchester United's Bruno Fernandes rues a missed chance during the English Premier League soccer match between Leeds United and Manchester United at Elland Road. (is associated with: «Fernandes set to avoid sanctions over post-match Carrick criticism») Annabel Lee-Ellis/PA Wire/dpa Bruno Fernandes is expected to avoid disciplinary action following the Manchester United captain’s outburst in Como – and is being supported by the club after a robbery at his house while he was in Italy. A catastrophic night in Lombardy saw United suffer a humiliating 4-1 loss to Cesc Fabregas’ side, which extended their winless run to seven fixtures and led to Fernandes publicly questioning the approach of boss Michael Carrick. The result, alongside Fernandes’ comments, had raised serious questions about Carrick’s future ahead of Sunday’s Premier League home game against Bournemouth, but the Press Association understands he will remain in charge for that match. United skipper Fernandes has been a pale imitation of last season’s performer so far this term, and questioned Carrick’s tactics as another Champions League trip ended with an eye-catching post-match player interview following on from last week’s remarks by Lisandro Martinez. Fernandes claimed it was the staff’s decision “not to press man-to-man and sometimes leave a little bit of space in behind” in Como. Yet, the Press Association understands United are not expected to punish Fernandes for his impassioned post-match interview a week on from Martinez’s caustic remarks, which led to a fine and talks with the club hierarchy. The Portuguese then returned from Italy with the squad in the early hours of Thursday morning and had to deal with a robbery at his house that took place while he was overseas. Fernandes’ family are understood not to have been in the house at the time and police quickly attended the scene, with United supporting their skipper. The 32-year-old’s comments and role are sure to be among the main topics at Friday’s press conference nominally previewing the Bournemouth match. Carrick already addressed Fernandes’ remarks in Como, saying: “We actually half-pressed man-to-man in the second half and then conceded a goal from that. “And there’s a little bit on whatever system you play, whatever tactics you play, if you don’t run, and you don’t run forward, and you don’t run back, you aren’t going to win.”

item.title: Giants coach rips poor effort of ‘traitors’
item.description: Giants defensive coordinator Dennard Wilson was not happy with the effort some of his players showed in Sunday’s loss to the Saints. He made that quite clear Thursday. “We’ve got to come downhill, and we’ve got to tackle,” Wilson said. “Last week was one of our worst tackling games, for whatever reason. A few plays got out, especially in the pass game, because of missed tackles. “And I wasn’t happy with our effort running to the ball. We put some stuff on tape that was not characteristic of a New York Giant defense. It’s unacceptable, and it will be changed.” So how does Wilson deal with this? “Well, you confront it,” he said. “When you’re in the meeting room, you show those plays. I look at guys that don’t run to the ball, and I call them traitors — because they’re traitors to the defense. And when you have a traitor to the defense, you either have to make adjustments to get him off the field — or they have to correct their behaviors. “Last week, we did not on every play run to the ball, and it was unacceptable. The guys know it. This week, when you see them out there, they will be flying around 100 mph with their hair on fire. “If your effort is bad, if you have a lack of toughness, it gets pointed out. When you have behaviors that are unacceptable, we’re not going to accept it. And if you don’t change the behaviors, we have to change the players.” As the Giants fell 34-27 to New Orleans last week, they trailed 34-10 until seven minutes remained in the game. Though Wilson didn’t name any names on Thursday, it’s clear that safeties Jason Pinnock and Jevon Holland could have done more while pursuing Alvin Kamara on his 31-yard catch-and-run touchdown, which broke a 10-10 tie early in the third quarter. The Saints led the rest of the way. On that play, Tremaine Edmunds, Jihad Ward (who has since been cut) and Dru Phillips also appeared to show lackluster effort. Holland suffered a concussion in that game and didn’t practice Wednesday, so he might not play this week. All told, the Giants allowed 319 yards (not a ton) against the Saints, though they gave up 175 on the ground. A week earlier, Washington hung 202 rushing yards on the Giants during a dramatic tie. Entering Sunday’s game at the Texans (who have an excellent defense), the Giants’ defense is ninth in Pro Football Focus’ ratings, including 10th against the run, 17th in pass rush and 11th in coverage. Stopping the run more capably was a big-time focus for Wilson coming into this season, his first year in East Rutherford. Wilson has done a solid job, all things considered, especially since he lost his best player — outside linebacker Brian Burns — to a season-ending knee injury in Week 3 against the Titans. In terms of total yardage allowed, the Giants have gotten truly gashed in just one game, as the Rams hung 481 on them in Week 2. item.title: Trump says NBA star LeBron James disrespected US anthem and demands apology
item.description: LeBron James [NBAE via Getty Images] President Donald Trump has said basketball star LeBron James disrespected the US by not being still while the national anthem was sung. James, who now plays for the Philadelphia 76ers, appeared to be practising a golf swing and basketball shots as the anthem was being performed ahead of the season-opening match against the New York Knicks on Wednesday. "While listening to our National Anthem, LeBron James disrespects our Country!," Trump posted on social media. "LeBron James should apologize to all of those Great American Warriors and Heroes who died for the American Flag." James has not responded to the president's latest comments but the pair have criticised each other in the past. James can be seen in a video making the motion of a golf swing as a performer sings the Star-Spangled Banner at New York's Madison Square Garden. His teammates, who are lined up next to him on the court, mostly remain standing with minimal movement. "I said right from the beginning that he's no good, a TOTAL DISGRACE," Trump added, referring to James. The BBC has contacted James for comment through the 76ers and has also asked the team to comment. The US anthem is played or performed at the start of most professional sports games. Players and spectators are expected to stand for it, if they can, and refrain from moving around. Some people sing along. This tradition has become a political flash-point before. In 2016, former American football player Colin Kaepernick sat down and later knelt on one knee during the anthem as a demonstration against police brutality and racism in the US. Trump criticised Kaepernick and later took credit when the athlete could not find a team to play for. Years later, he softened his stance saying Kaepernick should "get another shot" to play in the NFL. The president has had a longstanding feud with James, who has publicly endorsed or campaigned for Trump's political opponents since the 2016 presidential election In 2018, Trump suggested James was not intelligent after the athlete said he "would never sit across" from him. That same year, James accused Trump of giving racists "an opportunity to be out and outspoken without fear". He has also suggested that Trump's rhetoric led to a mob storming the US Capitol in 2021 to stop the certification of the result of the 2020 election, which former President Joe Biden won. James had endorsed Biden. In July, when asked to choose between James and Michael Jordan as the all-time greatest basketball player in history, Trump said he preferred Jordan. "I only like people that like me," Trump said. Trump condemns NFL anthem protest 'Maybe he's a racist' - Trump critical of James

The BBC has contacted James for comment through the 76ers and has also asked the team to comment. The US anthem is played or performed at the start of most professional sports games. Players and spectators are expected to stand for it, if they can, and refrain from moving around. Some people sing along. This tradition has become a political flash-point before. In 2016, former American football player Colin Kaepernick sat down and later knelt on one knee during the anthem as a demonstration against police brutality and racism in the US. Trump criticised Kaepernick and later took credit when the athlete could not find a team to play for. Years later, he softened his stance saying Kaepernick should "get another shot" to play in the NFL. The president has had a longstanding feud with James, who has publicly endorsed or campaigned for Trump's political opponents since the 2016 presidential election In 2018, Trump suggested James was not intelligent after the athlete said he "would never sit across" from him. That same year, James accused Trump of giving racists "an opportunity to be out and outspoken without fear". He has also suggested that Trump's rhetoric led to a mob storming the US Capitol in 2021 to stop the certification of the result of the 2020 election, which former President Joe Biden won. James had endorsed Biden. In July, when asked to choose between James and Michael Jordan as the all-time greatest basketball player in history, Trump said he preferred Jordan. "I only like people that like me," Trump said. Trump condemns NFL anthem protest 'Maybe he's a racist' - Trump critical of James

item.title: Celebration Bowl introduces interesting way to identify HBCU contenders
item.description: Celebration Bowl introduces interesting way to identify HBCU contenders appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Cricket Celebration Bowl is giving HBCU football fans a new way to track the race to Atlanta. The game’s organizers have released the inaugural Toyota Championship Projection, a weekly model that estimates each MEAC and SWAC team’s odds of earning a spot in the HBCU national championship game. Executive Director of the Toyota Celebration Bowl, John T. Grant, spoke about the Championship Projections. “The conversations around who is playing the best football, who has the toughest road and what the numbers are really telling us have been happening behind the scenes for years. This projection model tool helps bring those conversations to the public. The tool gives fans, media and the HBCU football community more context around the championship races, the teams’ paths and how the numbers are changing from week to week. It does not replace what happens on the field, and it is not meant to tell us who will win. It is a tool to help us better understand the road to Atlanta and create more informed conversation around the Celebration Bowl.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) The statistical model weighs a team’s overall strength, strength of schedule, scoring efficiency, conference standing, remaining games and game locations, then plays out the rest of the conference season 10,000 times. A team’s percentage reflects how often it reaches the Celebration Bowl across those simulations. The first numbers show Morgan State as the clear MEAC favorite, with a 63.4% chance of reaching Atlanta. In the SWAC, Jackson State leads the East Division at 49.5% and is the most likely overall champion at 40.3%, followed by Alabama A&M at 29.9%. Grambling State paces the more open West Division at 41.6%. The projection will be updated each week as results come in, ahead of the Dec. 12 game at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Overall projections for both the MEAC and SWAC are below, with a more detailed breakdown on the Celebration Bowl website.
